name: Kuk-Il Paper Mfg Co.,Ltd
summary: Kuk-Il Paper Mfg Co.,Ltd, established in 1978 and headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, is a prominent producer and supplier of an extensive array of paper products throughout the nation. The company's diverse portfolio addresses various industrial needs, including specialized papers for metals and automobiles such as steel interleaving, pasting, and electrical insulation. For the tobacco industry, they provide essential components like plug wrap, a range of filter papers (including combined performance, paper, and foil inner liners), and oil-resistant tip papers. Beyond these, Kuk-Il innovates with materials for advanced filtration, offering reverse osmosis membrane papers and humidifier filter media, alongside non-woven lining papers and those designed for heat exchanger transfer. Their substantial contribution to industrial printing and packaging encompasses kraft, silk/flame retardant wall, security, fruit wrapping, and sublimation heat transfer papers. The company also caters to consumer and food packaging markets with products such as tissue, envelope, base papers for pain relief patches, paper straws, gum wrapping, and wood-free fine papers. Completing their comprehensive offerings are specialized items like double-sided basis, release, garment tag, sterilizing, paper point, and paper band papers.
